entries.title: Autonomous job and template engine: job construction exact against Core, extranonce spaces partitionable without collision
entries.measured_result: Real defect found and fixed in production: SoloServer.refresh_job applied a full-coinbase extranonce offset to the stripped coinbase, corrupting the served scriptSig by 2 bytes on witness templates; fix at mining/solo_server.py line 270 (stripped.index). Job construction verified against Core (engine block 1105, solo block 1104, coinbase value 39,079,798 sats). Extranonce collision confirmed then fixed with opt-in MiningEngine extranonce_space, default (0, 64) byte-identical to historical behaviour; disjoint spaces verified; 7 out-of-range spaces refused. 21 checks in tests/test_exp034_job_template.py

entries.title: Exact candidate verification and block submission: integer-only verdicts, chain-confirmed acceptance
entries.measured_result: mining/candidate_verify.py in production: hashlib plus pure-Python agreement required, integer check_pow with Core SetCompact semantics, no float operations in the file; solo submitblock None no longer treated as success; pool and solo paths both route through verify_candidate; regtest blocks 1028 and 1029 through the fixed paths

entries.title: Mining statistics and probability engine: whole-log evidence census, separated counters, adopted probability formulas
entries.measured_result: EvidenceCounter streams the whole log once then incrementally, persisting offset, counts and fingerprint atomically; mining/mining_statistics.py holds all directive section-10 categories as separated counters with no combined total (pinned by test); mining/probability.py adopts expected_hashes(D) = D x 2^32 and prob_at_least_one = 1 - exp(-R t / (D x 2^32)), anchor-pinned and cross-checked against exact rational arithmetic. Phase 002 step 4 added the percentile family (quantile, median, percentile, exact-Fraction forms, period probabilities) with 73 checks, and wired statistics into mainnet_live.py, stratum_client.py (optional hook) and MiningEngine (optional parameter)

entries.title: Autonomous mining operations: exact work checkpointing that can never record unfinished work as completed
entries.measured_result: mining/work_checkpoint.py records an exact (extranonce, nonce) frontier keyed by the EXP-025 layered identity plus extranonce space plus curtime basis; the frontier advances only after a batch returns without a hit. MiningEngine gains opt-in checkpoint_path (default None); agent/autonomous.py is the only production caller

entries.title: Stable numeric incident code registry for faults, recoveries and backend refusals (Whatsminer documentation lineage)
entries.measured_result: INTEGRATED by NOVA-ER-0006 (2026-11-17): append-only incident code registry mining/incident_registry.json (20 coarse codes, groups 1xxx miner lifecycle, 2xxx supervisor lifecycle, 3xxx self-update, 4xxx work and report integrity, 5xxx upstream and verification) with mining/incident_codes.py as the validation layer (unknown codes refused with ValueError, check_append_only enforces the append-only discipline). Emission wired at 11 predeclared sites in mining/autopilot.py (log lines gain a [code] prefix token; heartbeat.json gains an incident_counts field) and as statistics keying in mining/mining_statistics.py (record() of stale_reports, duplicate_deliveries and leases_abandoned keys 4001, 4002 and 4003; record_incident API; incident_snapshot() view, with snapshot() shape unchanged under its EXP-037 pin). Gate 3 (refusal, append-only enforcement, site coverage) and Gate 5 (isolated byte-copy autopilot instance end to end, plus a replay over the recorded corpus: all 165 autopilot log lines and every evidence fault class mapped to exactly one code) passed; tests/test_incident_codes.py 34 checks, neighbours test-autopilot, test-mainnet-live, test-exp037, test-exp057 passed. Codes annotate records and change no behaviour; removing the field restores prior shapes. Design note and full record: research/EXTREME_RESEARCH/NOVA_ER_0006_DESIGN.md and NOVA_ER_0006_REPORT.md.
